senses.gloss:
Aikṣvāka, ‘descendant of Ikṣvāku,’ is the patronymic borne
by Purukutsa in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa.^1 Another Aikṣvāka
is Vārṣṇi, a teacher mentioned in the Jaiminīya Upaniṣad
Brāhmaṇa.^2 A king Hariścandra Vaidhasa Aikṣvāka is known
to the Aitareya Brāhmaṇa,^3 and Tryaruṇa is an Aikṣvāka in
the Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa.^4
1) xiii. 5, 4, 5.
2) i. 5, 4.
3) vii. 13, 16.
4) xiii. 3, 12.
